_about: Controlled values for the task.toml [metadata] fields of spec 5.2 (languages, frameworks, architecture, source_origin). tools/leak_scan.py fails a task whose value is not listed here. package_versions values must be exact version strings (no range operators); python is the exact interpreter version in the task image.

architecture_descriptions.batch_agent_pipeline: An agent or chain run once per input record in a batch job (for example one model call per CSV row).
architecture_descriptions.llm_chain: A fixed chain or prompt pipeline around a model call, with no agent loop choosing tools.
architecture_descriptions.multi_agent: Two or more agents that hand work or messages to each other.
architecture_descriptions.single_agent: One agent loop without tools that reach outside the process (instructions, validation, tracing).
architecture_descriptions.single_agent_rag: One agent whose tools retrieve documents or web pages into the model context.
architecture_descriptions.single_agent_tool_calling: One agent that calls tools acting on files, code, URLs, databases or other resources.
